_: Which shell tool results attach a PR to the chat that ran them. Run by packages/shared/src/pr.test.ts and crates/nekko-store/src/pr.rs. The commands are the shapes agents really use.

cases.name: Claude Code heredoc body
cases.command:
gh pr create --title "Fix" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- one; two | three
EOF
)"

cases.name: warnings before the URL, trimmed output
push then create then arm auto-merge
cases.command: git push -u origin fix 2>&1 | tail -2 && gh pr create --title "Fix" --body-file /tmp/pr.md && gh pr merge --auto --squash
cases.output:

https://github.com/o/r/pull/9

cases.name: body written by a heredoc first
cases.command:
cat > /tmp/pr.md <<'EOF'
Closes #1. It's done; really | truly.
EOF
gh pr create --title "Fix" --body-file /tmp/pr.md

cases.command:

cases.name: PowerShell assignment then echo
cases.command: $u = gh pr create --draft --title "Fix" --body-file .pr-body.md; $u; gh pr merge $u --auto --squash

cases.name: a stack of two creates
cases.command: gh pr create --fill --base main && git checkout b && gh pr create --fill --base a

cases.name: more bare URLs than creates is ambiguous
